name: Custom — any task (bring your own scorer)
summary: The general on-ramp: optimize ANY artifact against ANY deterministic scorer (not just trading or tests). Ships a tiny runnable example — improve a tagline by a text rubric — that you replace: edit metrics/evaluate.py to read your artifact and print {"score": N}, and edit the seed to be the thing you optimize.

executor.task: Edit solution.txt to maximize the score — rewrite it freely. Do NOT modify or run anything under ../metrics/ (the scorer). One focused change per step.

validator.goal: Review the artifact and the change: your honest opinion on the approach, why the score moved, and one or two concrete ideas to try next.
